diagnostics.message: :resource.null_resource.wait_for_cluster: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_eks_cluster.this is redundant — already implied by attribute references

The explicit dependency from :resource.null_resource.wait_for_cluster to :resource.aws_eks_cluster.this duplicates the existing implicit dependency: the provisioner environment references the cluster endpoint, and the null resource's depends_on also lists the cluster.

The explicit dependency from :resource.aws_eks_cluster.this to :resource.aws_cloudwatch_log_group.this duplicates an implicit reference because the cluster's enabled_cluster_log_types uses the same log types configured for the log group, making the log group a direct prerequisite.

The worker Auto Scaling group :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.workers can launch instances before the worker IAM policies are attached; it has no dependency on :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.workers_AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy, which is required for nodes to bootstrap correctly.

The worker Auto Scaling group :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.workers can launch instances before the CNI policy is attached, potentially leaving nodes without required networking permissions; it has no dependency on :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.workers_AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy.

The worker Auto Scaling group :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.workers_launch_template can launch instances before the worker node policy is attached; it has no dependency on :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.workers_AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy, needed for node bootstrap.

The worker Auto Scaling group :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.workers_launch_template can launch instances before the CNI policy is attached, potentially leaving nodes without required networking permissions; it has no dependency on :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.workers_AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy.
